scope: opt-in WASI-only managed access query and explicitly authorized open errno correction

upstream.source_hash_basis: Full UTF-8 file bytes read from primary GitHub at the fixed commit; Git blob SHA-1 recomputed. Builder independently verifies checkout HEAD and complete base files.

activation.opt_in: apply this patch only to an independent managed-access profile
activation.native_processing: existing branches retained; header and hooks preprocessor-excluded on native builds

protocol.transport: libc fopen r+b; one open per transaction; no PHP stream/stat
protocol.relative_path: bounded VCWD_GETCWD when defined, otherwise libc getcwd; append slash/path without symlink or dot normalization

statuses.3: unmanaged; existing access fallback and incoming errno retained

protocol.local_failures: invalid mode/path EINVAL; overlong absolute path or cwd expansion ENAMETOOLONG; never unmanaged
protocol.failure_policy: incomplete/malformed/extra response, IO or close failure => EIO and false; only explicit complete status3 permits VCWD_ACCESS fallback
protocol.open_errno_policy: only original failed open EPERM and same path/O_ACCMODE query status1 => EACCES; all other statuses/errors preserve original EPERM; no retry or success change

open_gates: standard Git apply against independently fetched fixed source
build with the existing Fiber and CGI patches in one dedicated profile
Rust pure query provider and bounded transport integration
unchanged native runtime and Fiber corpora on both Linux backends
transport faults fail closed; errno conversion only on explicit matching-path denial
source/license/resource and deployment gates remain separate
